hero.title: Your business. All in one place.
hero.subtitle: Messages, customers, orders, payments, stock and delivery — one connected flow instead of six disconnected apps.
hero.demoMessage: Do you have the black one in M?
hero.lead: APSA is designed to connect Facebook, Instagram and Telegram messages with orders, payments and delivery — one workspace built for Cambodian sellers.

problem.title: Six tools. One lost customer.
problem.body: A message arrives on Facebook. The payment lands in a bank app. Delivery lives in a courier chat. The record ends in a notebook. Nothing talks to anything.
problem.result: APSA joins them into one line.
problem.pain1: Customers send on Facebook, Instagram and Telegram — at the same time.
problem.pain2: Payment confirmation is a screenshot in another app.
problem.pain3: Delivery address repeated every single order.
problem.pain4: Order history lives in a notebook or nowhere.
problem.pain5: Staff give wrong price or wrong stock.
problem.pain6: Follow-up forgotten because Inbox was too full.

inbox.title: Every channel in one inbox
inbox.body: Designed for Facebook, Instagram and Telegram conversations — in a single list, with follow-up status on every thread so nothing goes quiet by accident.

flow.title: Your complete business flow
flow.body: The customer is already filled in. Pick the product, pick the variant, create the order. The thread records it for you.
flow.step1desc: A message arrives from any channel.
flow.step2desc: Customer record is linked to the order.
flow.step4desc: Staff confirms cash, KHQR or transfer.
flow.step5desc: Courier details and COD amount recorded.

ops.title: Orders, payment, delivery
ops.body: Six operational modules in one workspace. No switching between apps, no data entry twice.
ops.ordersBody: One order, one full story — items, staff, timeline.
ops.paymentBody: Cash, KHQR or transfer. Marked paid by a human, never guessed.
ops.deliveryBody: Record courier details, tracking numbers and COD amounts in one place.
ops.posBody: Sell in-store with your phone. Cash, KHQR or bank transfer.
ops.customersBody: Complete history and notes for every customer, across all channels.
ops.teamBody: Five roles from owner to cashier. Everyone sees only what they need.

history.title: History that prevents wrong orders
history.body: Every customer carries their sizes, their address, their last purchase and their notes — so the second order is easier than the first.

cambodia.title: Built for how Cambodia buys
cambodia.body: Every payment method, every courier, every language — made for the way sellers and buyers here actually work.
cambodia.khqrBody: Built to support KHQR, Cambodia's national QR payment standard.
cambodia.currencyBody: Both currencies, riel rounded to the nearest 100.
cambodia.couriersBody: Built to support J&T, VET, Capital and Grab Express.
cambodia.khmerBody: Khmer is the default language, not an afterthought.

cta.title: Never lose a customer, message, order, payment or follow-up again.
cta.body: Set up your shop in minutes. No card, no contract.

msgToOrder.title: Message to order in three taps
msgToOrder.body: A customer asks a question. In three taps it becomes an order — customer, product and price already in place. You just confirm.
msgToOrder.step1msg: Do you have the black one in M?

c360.title: Know the customer before you reply
c360.body: Every customer carries their full history — sizes, address, last purchase and notes. The second order is faster than the first.

lteam.title: Grow from one seller to a full team
lteam.body: Start alone. Add staff when you're ready. Every role has the right access from day one.
lteam.ownerDesc: Full access including money and team.
lteam.salesDesc: Replies to customers and order creation.

apsi.title: Built with care, for Cambodian sellers
apsi.body: APSA was designed around how Cambodian merchants actually sell — through messages, trust and relationships. That's why it feels right.

apsi.title: You replied to 26 messages today.
apsi.body: That's your best day this week. Three follow-ups are still waiting.

empty.title: Today is quiet
empty.body: No orders yet. Your first sale will show up here.

error.title: Today's numbers didn't load
error.body: The data didn't come back. Check your connection and try again.

design.title: APSA design system
design.subtitle: Tokens, type, and every component in every state. Reviewed before screens.
design.sheetBody: Drag the handle, press Escape, or tap the scrim to close.

empty.body: Try another name or phone number, or create a new customer.

returnSheet.title: Start a return
returnSheet.body: A return moves goods back. It does not send money back.

refundSheet.title: Refund money
refundSheet.body: A refund moves money. It does not assume the goods came back.
refundSheet.invalid: Enter an amount greater than zero.

paymentSheet.title: Record payment
paymentSheet.body: You are confirming money you already received. APSA does not check with the bank.

deliverySheet.title: Arrange delivery
deliverySheet.body: Choose a courier. APSA records it for you — no courier is contacted.
